title: Function-preserving watermarking of AI-generated proteins.
authors: Stutz, David; Cowen-Rivers, Alexander I; Ortiz-Jimenez, Guillermo; Ratcliff, Jeremy; Zambaldi, Vinicius; Willmore, Lindsay; Abramson, Josh; Patani, Harshnira; Kouridi, Christina; Stimberg, Florian; Vecerik, Mel; Chu, Alex; Singh, Sukhdeep; Dathathri, Sumanth; Papa, Eliseo; De Bortoli, Valentin; Doucet, Arnaud; Hassabis, Demis; Wang, Jue; Gowal, Sven; Kohli, Pushmeet
one_liner_zh: 该文提出SynthIDBio方法，在AI生成的蛋白质序列和结构中嵌入保持功能的数字水印，涉及蛋白质结构预测与设计，并利用微调AlphaFold3模型，属于蛋白质结构计算与AI方法创新。
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) models are revolutionizing biology, with tools such as AlphaFold 3 and protein design models accelerating breakthroughs in protein structure prediction and the creation of new functional proteins(1). Tracking and establishing the provenance of AI-generated protein sequences and structures is becoming increasingly important to tackle a range of emerging challenges, including biosecurity and concerns about information veracity(2-4). Here we introduce SynthIDBio, a family of methods for watermarking protein sequences and structures to establish the provenance of those generated with AI. SynthIDBio-sequence actively embeds a watermark into protein sequences while preserving function. We demonstrate this by creating watermarked, functional designed protein binders with binding affinity comparable with non-watermarked counterparts and near-perfect watermark detection accuracy. Furthermore, SynthIDBio-structure, a fine-tuned AlphaFold3 model, embeds an imperceptible watermark into biomolecular structures. Our work is a proof-of-concept that function-preserving biological watermarking is feasible, introducing a potential tool for provenance in the rapidly expanding era of AI-driven biological engineering.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）模型正在彻底改变生物学领域，诸如AlphaFold 3和蛋白质设计模型等工具加速了蛋白质结构预测及新型功能蛋白质创造方面的突破(1)。追踪并确立AI生成蛋白质序列和结构的来源，对于应对一系列新兴挑战（包括生物安全及信息真实性担忧）正变得日益重要(2-4)。在此，我们介绍SynthIDBio，这是一系列用于对蛋白质序列和结构进行水印标记的方法，旨在确立AI生成内容的来源。SynthIDBio-sequence在保留功能的同时，主动将水印嵌入蛋白质序列中。我们通过创建带水印的功能性设计蛋白质结合剂来证明这一点，其结合亲和力与未加水印的对应物相当，且水印检测准确率近乎完美。此外，SynthIDBio-structure，一个微调后的AlphaFold3模型，将不可察觉的水印嵌入生物分子结构中。我们的工作是一个概念验证，表明保留功能的生物水印是可行的，为快速扩张的AI驱动生物工程时代引入了一种潜在的来源追踪工具。
